circuits.name: 1 · LED + resistor
circuits.desc: First circuit: light an LED safely with a current-limiting resistor (5 V).

steps.title: Connect the 5 V supply
steps.text: Red lead to the top + rail, black lead to the top − rail. Leave the power off for now.

steps.title: Red jumper: + rail → j8
steps.text: Brings the supply down into column 8.

steps.title: 220 Ω resistor: i8 → i14
steps.text: Bands: red-red-brown-gold. Limits the LED current to about 14 mA. Either way round is fine.

steps.title: Red LED: + in h14, − in h15
steps.text: Long leg (anode, +) into h14. Short leg / flat edge (cathode, −) into h15.

steps.title: Black jumper: j15 → − rail
steps.text: Completes the loop back to 0 V.

steps.title: Power on
steps.text: The LED should light. If it doesn't, check the LED is the right way round: it only conducts one way.

circuits.name: 2 · Push-button LED
circuits.desc: Use a push button to switch an LED, crossing the centre gap (5 V).

steps.title: Connect the 5 V supply
steps.text: Red lead to the top + rail, black lead to the top − rail. Leave the power off.

steps.title: Black jumper: link the − rails
steps.text: Top − rail to bottom − rail, so both halves of the board share 0 V.

steps.title: Push button across the centre gap
steps.text: Legs in e10, e12, f10, f12. If the LED later stays on without pressing, rotate the button 90°.

steps.title: Red jumper: + rail → j10
steps.text: Feeds the supply into one side of the button.

steps.title: 220 Ω resistor: b12 → b18
steps.text: Bands: red-red-brown-gold. Takes power from the other side of the button.

steps.title: Red LED: + in d18, − in d19
steps.text: Long leg (anode, +) into d18. Short leg / flat edge (cathode, −) into d19.

steps.title: Black jumper: a19 → bottom − rail
steps.text: Completes the loop back to 0 V.

steps.title: Power on and press the button
steps.text: The LED should light only while the button is held down.

circuits.name: 3 · Voltage divider
circuits.desc: Two equal resistors halve the supply voltage. Measure it with a multimeter (5 V).

steps.title: Connect the 5 V supply
steps.text: Red lead to the top + rail, black lead to the top − rail. Leave the power off.

steps.title: Red jumper: + rail → j8
steps.text: Brings the supply down into column 8.

steps.title: 10 kΩ resistor (R1): i8 → i14
steps.text: Bands: brown-black-orange-gold. The top half of the divider.

steps.title: 10 kΩ resistor (R2): h14 → h20
steps.text: Bands: brown-black-orange-gold. The bottom half. Column 14 is now the midpoint.

steps.title: Black jumper: j20 → − rail
steps.text: Closes the divider to 0 V.

steps.title: Power on and measure Vout
steps.text: Multimeter on DC volts: red probe on g14, black probe on the − rail. Expect about 2.5 V, half of 5 V.
